summaries.n-tokenized-assets: Coins whose metadata describes tokenized stocks or real-world assets (RWAs). @RobinhoodCrypto posted on 2026-10-08 that it is exploring a Stock Token linked to an actively managed ETF with T. Rowe Price DA ("if successful"), and on 2026-09-08 that Robinhood Stock Tokens had reached $150M in TVL on Robinhood Chain. Apps built around those tokens have coins of their own: Borro.Markets (BORRO; "Lend, borrow and short stock tokens"), HyperDex (HYDX; "Unified Marketplace for Tokenized Assets & RWAs"), Prism Assets (PRISM; "tokenising real-world assets with AI"), Longbow (BOW; borrow USDG against tokenized stocks and RWAs), Quanta Pools (QUANTA; liquidity across Stock Tokens and RWAs), Mintfolio (MINTFOLIO; baskets of stocks and ETFs), TARTAGLIA (TATA; "ZK dark pool for tokenized stocks"), and two pons coins created on 2026-10-11, HUME MARKETS (HUME; "Tokenized stocks, all in one place. Perps. Options. Lending & Borrowing.") and Ballast (BLLS; "Stock Token portfolios on @Robinhoodapp that rebalance themselves"). On Solana, Tokenize Everything (EVERYTHING; pool created 2026-10-07) describes tokenized RWAs as the biggest crypto meta of the last year and a half; one 2026-10-07 post by @RaOnChain called it a scam. @ClutchMarkets and @Hookrfun posted on 2026-10-13 about StonkBrokers hooks and a "Pair Token" (two stock tokens fused into one ERC-20) on Robinhood Chain; no coin here is shown to be part of that. None of the coins is shown to be issued by or affiliated with Robinhood, and their product descriptions are their own claims. VERDEX (VERDEX; "The front door to tokenized markets. 226 real-world assets, 12 issuers, 70 chains, one order.", pons) was added on 2026-10-13. Measured: eleven coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-super-intelligence: On Sept. 29 Trump said AI would officially be renamed "Super Intelligence" (Fox News). On 2026-10-04 the official @WhiteHouse account posted an announcement of a "Super Intelligence Force (SIF)", and Watcher.Guru and an @wallstreetbets post reported Elon Musk saying SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI. Super Inu ($SI), launched Sept. 21, re-pitched itself around the term; other coins followed, including another SI on pump.fun, 四 ("four", read as SI) on four.meme, Super Intelligence Force (SIF), Superintelligence Owl, two SpaceXSI coins on StonkFun, SpaceX Inu ($SI on Flap), Act II: The SI Prophecy, SuperHooks, two newer pump.fun coins, SpaceX Super Intelligence (SPACEXSI) and My Super Intelligent Cat (Ollie), whose metadata names the term, and two BNB Chain coins on Flap named TeslaSI ("Tesla Super Intelligence", pool created 2026-10-11, and a second whose Chinese metadata says it follows the SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI rename). None is shown to be affiliated with the announcements. Smaller coins named for SpaceXSI under the $100K market cap bar are not counted. Measured: sixteen coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-credits-for-holders: Coins that describe turning trading fees into AI model credits for holders. Orbio (orbio.so) says it sells LLM credits at a discount, that the discount comes from Orbio holders who offer unused credit, and that requests are relayed through its managed OpenRouter account; its coin ORBIO (pons, Robinhood Chain) says half of trading fees are converted into inference credits paid to holders. API (pump.fun) says fees are split by holdings and holders can claim SOL or 1.5x credits for GPT, Claude, Grok and Gemini through one OpenAI-compatible API; LLMPad (LLM, pump.fun) says it lets anyone launch model tokens or trading agents and generate LLM credits; bInference (BINF, Flap, BNB Chain) says an agent token's fees pay for the agent's AI and that credits bought with BNB are up to 8% cheaper with $BINF. Public posts from 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10 compare BINF and API with ORBIO, and a rival project, DecentraMind, says ORBIO pioneered the model it builds on. The ORBIO and BINF pools date from 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-30; the API and LLM pools were created on 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10. These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts, discounts and usage are not verified, no affiliation among the coins was checked, and one post says 11 bundles bought 62% of LLM's supply around its launch. Measured: four coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-creator-fee-routing: Coins whose metadata says their creator or trading fees are routed to a named person or account. UsePaid's page (usepaid.app, scraped 2026-10-14) says it routes each coin's creator fees to the X account the coin is launched for, held for that user to claim; MarsX and slopcannon say "Fees to @arikuschnir via UsePaid" and "Fees to @boneGPT via UsePaid". TeleMoney (TM) says it launches coins on pump.fun with fees redirected to any Telegram username, and @TeleMoneySOL posted on 2026-10-12 that 108 coins had launched, 262.8 SOL of creator fees had been generated and 17,411.2 GRAM paid out. Cashed Money (CASHED, pons on Robinhood Chain) says "Fees to @GetCashedMoney via Cashed", WIRED (Flap, BNB Chain) says token launches have fees wired to social media accounts, and Pepper The Raccoon says it redirects fees to its owner, and The Embryo Corporation (UNICORN, pump.fun) says "Fees to @josiezayner via UsePaid". A 2026-10-12 @PickACycle post says a pump.fun coin's fees can now be split between UsePaid, OTC desks and agencypad. The pools date from 2026-09-18 (Cashed Money) to 2026-10-13 (UNICORN). These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts are not verified, no affiliation among the coins was checked, and MarsX traded over 10x its market cap on 2026-10-13. Measured: seven coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-programmable-rules: Coins from launchpads whose tokens carry rules enforced on-chain. Hooked (HOOKED, on Meteora's dynamic bonding curve) says rules are built into the token with Token-2022 transfer hooks, and the @MeteoraEco account described it on 2026-10-04 as letting builders choose who can hold, how tokens trade and who gets rewarded. SPEC (spec.fun's own page: Solana programmable extension coins, 73 extensions) and HOOKI (@Hoookedpad's 2026-10-05 post: an AI agent that rewrites a token's rules on Hooked) are on Solana; pickhooks (hooks, on Flap) describes itself in its metadata as a launchpad on BNB Chain where coins carry rules, and its own account announced version 2 on 2026-10-04. IGNITION (pons, Robinhood Chain; created 2026-10-13) says in its metadata it is building a token launchpad where nothing is locked in and the hook logic can be rewritten after launch. @Hoookedpad posted a new Options hook on 2026-10-12 and @Hookrfun a StonkBrokers hook on 2026-10-13. These are project descriptions; whether the rules work as described, and any affiliation among the five coins beyond the Hooked-HOOKI link, is not verified, and one public review notes hooks are not permanent by default. Measured: five coins across all their pools.
